era_note: 1500 is the eve of everything. Latin Christendom stands unified for the last time, seventeen years before the theses; Granada has just fallen, ending eight centuries of al-Andalus, and the same decade's expulsions scatter Sephardi Jewry east; Iran is Sunni here and Shia on the next plate; and the Americas render in the land tone of religious worlds about to be overwhelmed, eight years after Columbus. The Ottoman Balkans state this map's standing principle at full volume: this plate colors what people practiced, never who ruled them, and Christian-majority lands under the sultan render Christian.
